lesson_name: Why the Vikings came to Britain

photos.subject: A farm on a Norwegian fjord: steep mountains dropping almost to the water, with a narrow strip of flat green farmland and farm buildings beside the shore
photos.pedagogical_constraint: The mountain and the flat strip are both in frame, so how little flat land there is can be seen at a glance.
photos.teaching_requirement: See that good flat farmland in Viking Scandinavia was a thin strip between the mountain and the water, so a family could run out of it.
load_bearing_evidence: steep mountainside coming close to the water
a narrow strip of flat farmland beside the water
farm buildings or worked fields on that strip
the water of a fjord

generation_prompt.physical_state: A working farm on a narrow flat shelf of green land between a steep mountainside and the still water of a fjord, in summer.
generation_prompt.text_rule: no readable text, labels, logos or branding
generation_prompt.composition: Landscape frame showing the mountain, the flat strip and the water together.

photos.subject: Lindisfarne, also called Holy Island, off the Northumberland coast, seen from across the water, with the priory ruins on the low flat island
photos.pedagogical_constraint: Shows the island as low, small and open from the sea, with no wall or defence around it.
photos.teaching_requirement: See that the monastery raided in 793 sat on a small open island with nothing between it and the sea.
load_bearing_evidence: the island seen from across the water
the priory buildings or ruins on it
low open ground with no defensive wall
the sea or the shoreline
photos.fallback_note: A generated island would be a lie about Lindisfarne. The lesson names this place and this year, and the class is being asked what they can see about the real island.

photos.subject: The carved Anglo-Saxon stone from Lindisfarne, often called the Domesday stone, showing a row of figures carrying raised axes and swords
photos.pedagogical_constraint: The row of armed figures is clear enough to read at slide size.
photos.teaching_requirement: Put a real carved image of a raid beside the word raid.
load_bearing_evidence: a carved stone slab
a row of human figures
raised axes or swords in their hands
photos.fallback_note: A generated carving would be an invented artefact presented as a real one from Lindisfarne. The vocabulary card still works with the word alone.

photos.subject: A Viking longship, either an excavated ship in a museum or a sailing replica, seen from the side so the shallow clinker-built hull is visible
photos.pedagogical_constraint: The whole hull is in frame from the side, so how shallow and flat-bottomed it is can be seen. No horned helmets and no fantasy dragon styling.
photos.teaching_requirement: See that a Viking ship was shallow enough to be rowed straight onto a beach, so no harbour was needed.
load_bearing_evidence: the whole length of a Viking longship from the side
the shallow, flat-bottomed clinker-built hull
the overlapping planks of the hull
oar positions or a row of shields along the side

generation_prompt.physical_state: A Viking longship seen from the side on calm water or on a beach, with a shallow clinker-built hull of overlapping planks and a row of round shields along the gunwale.
generation_prompt.text_rule: no readable text, labels, logos or branding
generation_prompt.composition: Landscape frame showing the whole ship from bow to stern, side on.

photos.subject: A reconstructed Viking-age longhouse with a turf roof, standing in its own ground with fields or worked land around it
photos.pedagogical_constraint: The house is whole and settled in a landscape, so it reads as somewhere people lived rather than a museum object on a plinth.
photos.teaching_requirement: Show what settling looked like: a Viking home with land around it.
load_bearing_evidence: a whole Viking-age longhouse
a turf or thatched roof
open worked ground or fields around it

generation_prompt.physical_state: A long low Viking-age house with turf growing on its roof and timber walls, standing on open worked ground with fields behind it, in daylight.
generation_prompt.text_rule: no readable text, labels, logos or branding
generation_prompt.composition: Landscape frame showing the whole house and the ground around it.

photos.subject: Wide flat arable farmland in the east of England, with ploughed or cropped fields running to a low horizon
photos.pedagogical_constraint: The land is visibly flat and open all the way to the horizon, with no hills, so it reads against the Norwegian fjord farm.
photos.teaching_requirement: See that the land Vikings settled on in eastern England was flat, wide and workable, which their own farmland was not.
load_bearing_evidence: flat open farmland running to a low horizon
ploughed or cropped fields
no hills or mountains in the frame

generation_prompt.physical_state: Wide flat English arable farmland under an open sky, ploughed or under crop, running level to a low horizon.
generation_prompt.text_rule: no readable text, labels, logos or branding
generation_prompt.composition: Landscape frame, low horizon, the flatness of the land obvious.
